name: resolve_ic_selectors
summary: Resolve a circuit holder's db and d0 to d5 pins and aliases, and report prefab and name-hash selectors (lbn, sbn) for the devices its batch instructions reach. Lists 12 by default. Read only.

help.text: lb, lbn, sb and sbn walk only the holder's data network, so stable_selectors lists the devices on it the scope shows; batch_device_count is how many (null: no data network, and batch instructions fail). A selector is unique when exactly one device on that network has the pair. Renaming a device alters its name hash. For a Console or Computer Lua board, db is the computer.

targets.summary: target_reference_ids and devices off the network.
targets.text: target_reference_ids evaluates just those devices; each must be one the scope shows (device_not_found otherwise). One off the network is listed with reachable false, unique false and ic10_example null: an lbn with its pair reads the reachable devices that share it, or none. collision_count counts reachable devices only.

target_reference_ids.description: Devices to evaluate, each one the scope shows; defaults to the devices on the holder's data network.
